description: A wand and a workshop - ranged attacks empowered by Continuum devices, one at a time.
_source_note: Rebuilt 6 Nov 2026 from the 40 real CoA Artificer talents (role DPS). ECHO FRAGMENTS DO NOT EXIST - Chronomancer is (MANA, None) and no ability generates a secondary resource - so CoA's entire Fragment/Distortion/Continuum economy is flattened to its unconditional form, the same call Venomancer Stalking's Brood Marks needed. What the Continuum spells DID gain is CoA's exclusivity: exclusive_group 'chronomancer_continuum' on Singularity Core and Flux Emitter means casting one drops the other, which is 'Can only have 1 Continuum spell active at a time' built exactly. Three talents port almost verbatim (Temporal Convergence, Wand Mastery, Borrowed Time) because they are cooldown and proc mechanics rather than resource counting. Six load-bearing unlocks, the most of any tree.

nodes.name: Artificer's Empowerment
nodes.description: Increases your Spirit by 24%.
nodes._source: CoA over 3 ranks: 'Increases your Spirit by 8%.' Three ranks at 8% is 24%, authored as the ceiling at one rank so talent_ranks.spread() divides it back into three - the opposite of hand-authoring max_points=3, which leaves the ceiling as the PER-RANK value and triples it in play. That bug shipped on Guardian Vanguard's Iron Guardian (promised 15% Stamina, delivered 45%) and on all four Gladiator Training nodes, and only a live character reading the stat back caught it. Spirit is this spec's whole stat: CoA converts it into ranged attack power, spell damage and hit. spirit_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS (character.py:1265 divides by 100).

nodes.name: Wand Master
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Wand of Time and Artificer's Wand by 10.8%.
nodes._source: CoA over 2 ranks: 'Increases the damage of Wand of Time and Artificer's Wand by 10%.' PORTS EXACTLY, both abilities, doubled for the two ranks. Was a pure scalar on our side. Per-ability damage keys are FRACTIONS.

nodes.name: Wand Expert
nodes.description: Increases your ranged attack power by 100% of your Spirit.
nodes._source: CoA level 20 passive: 'Increases your ranged attack power by 100% of your Spirit and your hit rating by 5% of your Spirit.' The first half PORTS EXACTLY - ranged_ap is in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS and spirit in STAT_CONVERSION_SOURCES. The second half is DROPPED: hit_rating is NOT a valid conversion target, which has now cost seven nodes half their text across six classes and is the single most-repeated mistake in this audit. Paired with Artificer's Empowerment this is the spec's engine - Spirit becomes ranged damage. Was a pure scalar on our side. A FRACTION.

nodes.name: Hyperwand
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Shatter Echo by 30% and your critical damage by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage and critical damage of your Shatter Echo by 30%.' The damage half is per-ability and exact. There is no per-ability critical-damage key paired with a per-ability damage key (crit_damage is global or by school), so the crit half becomes crit_damage_pct at a lower value, since it now applies to everything. crit_damage_pct is read at abilities.py:1438 and is a FRACTION. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Borrowed Time
nodes.description: Taking physical damage heals you for 10% of the damage dealt.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Taking Physical damage now heals you equal to 10% of the damage dealt. Can only occur once per sec.' PORTS ALMOST EXACTLY, and it is one of the few talents in this class that does. leech_pct is one of only THREE proc payloads that read the triggering hit's amount (the others being bonus_pct and smart heals), so '10% of the damage dealt' is literally what it computes. CoA's once-per-second becomes a 1-turn internal cooldown. The Physical-only filter is dropped: on_damage_taken gets no attacker and no ability_id from a monster, so there is nothing to test the school against - a limit that has bitten bonus_pct, cast_ability and ability_filter on this trigger too.

nodes.name: Artificer's Wand
nodes.description: Teaches Artificer's Wand, focusing the wand into a pair of rapid strikes.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Transforms your Unmake into Artificer's Wand. Focus to unleash 2 wand attacks dealing Ranged Weapon damage plus 5 over 1 seconds. Generates 1 Echo Fragment.' LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK - chronomancer_artificers_wand carries requires_talent and this is its only unlock node. CoA scales this off ECHO FRAGMENTS, which are not a resource this engine has: Chronomancer is (ResourceType.MANA, None) at abilities.py:151 and no Chronomancer ability carries a `generates` block, so there is nothing to count. Flattened to the unconditional version at roughly what CoA's typical Fragment count comes to. Same call as Venomancer Stalking's Brood Marks; the lesson both times is to check the resource before porting the talent, since Templar's Combo and Knight of Xoroth's Deathfire ARE real and did port. The ability replacing Unmake is also not a mechanism here (nothing swaps one ability for another), so both simply coexist.

nodes.name: Temporal Convergence
nodes.description: Your ranged attacks have a 40% chance to reset the cooldown of Wand of Time.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Wand of Time now has a 40% chance to reset its own cooldown.' PORTS ALMOST EXACTLY - reset_cooldown with a BARE LIST is a full reset, as against the {abilities, turns} form which only shaves turns; getting those two the wrong way round is an easy and silent mistake. The trigger is on_weapon_swing rather than Wand of Time specifically, because there is no per-ability proc trigger, and a wand spec swinging is the closest honest equivalent. Wand of Time has a 1-turn cooldown, so this effectively makes it spammable in bursts, which is what CoA's version does too.

nodes.name: Shatter Echo
nodes.description: Teaches Shatter Echo, flinging a distorted echo of your wand at the target.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Launch a distorted echo from your wand at an enemy, dealing 90% Ranged Weapon damage plus Arcane damage. Damage increased by 40% for each Echo Fragment consumed.' LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK. CoA scales this off ECHO FRAGMENTS, which are not a resource this engine has: Chronomancer is (ResourceType.MANA, None) at abilities.py:151 and no Chronomancer ability carries a `generates` block, so there is nothing to count. Flattened to the unconditional version at roughly what CoA's typical Fragment count comes to. Same call as Venomancer Stalking's Brood Marks; the lesson both times is to check the resource before porting the talent, since Templar's Combo and Knight of Xoroth's Deathfire ARE real and did port. The Fragment scaling is absorbed into Hyperwand's flat +30% instead, so the ability still hits hard for a talented Artificer.

nodes.name: Discovery
nodes.description: Your ranged attacks have a 30% chance to unleash a burst of Arcane damage and restore 30 mana.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Artificer's Wand and Wand of Time now grants Discovery for 30 sec, stacking 4 times. At 3 stacks, your next Wand of Time or Artificer's Wand causes an additional Arcane Damage, scaling with Spirit.' The at-3-stacks gate cannot be built - nothing reads a stack count - so the stacking bookkeeping collapses into a flat 30% chance for the payoff itself, which is the part the player actually sees. Folded in CoA's Archaeology ('Your Discovery now also generates 3% of your base mana and health') as the mana grant, since that talent exists only to modify this one. grant_resource takes a FLAT `amount` - there is no `pct_max` field, and inventing one on Witch Doctor's Spiritual Devotee would have granted NOTHING while passing every check. The health half is dropped; grant_resource does not do health. `school` only types the damage_flat payload; it is not a trigger-side filter.

nodes.name: Erode Armaments
nodes.description: Your ranged attacks have a 40% chance to sap the target's weapons, reducing the damage they deal for 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Wand attacks now reduce enemy attack power by 208 for 5 seconds.' PORTS ALMOST EXACTLY and is the node that justified Infinite's Mind Melt using flat AP too: CoA itself debuffs a flat attack power number on this class, so flat is the house style rather than a fudge. attack_power is one of only eight status stat_mods a monster reads, and it is FLAT - Monster.ability_power_bonus is 'Flat damage/healing swing from active buffs and debuffs'. 208 scaled down to 120 because our monster damage numbers are smaller than CoA's. 5 sec -> 2 turns.

nodes.name: Crystal Cannon
nodes.description: Teaches Crystal Cannon, a pair of quick lesser wand strikes that scale with your Spirit.
nodes._source: CoA level 30 passive: 'Casting Discordance now unleashes the Crystal Cannon, launching 2 quick lesser Wand attacks at the enemy over 1 sec, scaling with Spirit.' LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK. CoA has it fire automatically off Discordance, which needs a per-ability trigger that does not exist; Wand Mastery at tier 5 gives it a real proc instead, so the ability does end up firing on its own for a player who takes both. CoA's Splitting Time ('Crystal Cannon strikes 2 additional nearby enemies') is not built - nothing adds targets to an ability.

nodes.name: Magic Sensitivity
nodes.description: Your critical strikes increase the damage the target takes from you by 8% for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Critical strikes with Shatter Echo now increases the enemy's damage taken from you by 10% for 8 seconds.' PORTS ALMOST EXACTLY; only the Shatter-Echo scoping goes, since there is no per-ability proc trigger, and on_crit keeps CoA's critical requirement intact. 8 sec -> 3 turns, 10% -> 8% because it now fires off any crit. CAREFUL: bare damage_taken_pct is read RAW ON BOTH SIDES (monster.py adds the status mod with no division, unlike physical_ and magic_ which divide by 100), so 0.08 is 8% and authoring 8 would be +800% damage taken. Asserted in main(). Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Elder Wand
nodes.description: Your ranged attacks have a 30% chance to increase your ranged attack power for 5 turns, stacking up to 10 times.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Wand attacks now have a 30% chance to increase the damage of Artificer's Wand against the target by 3% for 15 seconds, stacking 10 times.' The chance, duration and stack count all port; what cannot is a per-ability damage bonus living inside a status effect, and 'against the target' would need the stack to sit on the enemy while buffing the caster. Turned into a caster-side ranged attack power ramp, which produces the same shape in play - keep swinging, hit harder - and still rewards a long fight. 15 sec -> 5 turns. max_stacks is genuinely honoured even though nothing can READ the count. Was a pure scalar on our side.

nodes.name: Singularity Core
nodes.description: Teaches Singularity Core, a Continuum device that empowers your wand.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Empower your Wand attacks to deal an additional 50% Ranged Weapon Damage plus additional Arcane damage for 3 sec plus 5 sec per Echo Fragment. Can only have 1 Continuum spell active at a time.' LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK. CoA scales this off ECHO FRAGMENTS, which are not a resource this engine has: Chronomancer is (ResourceType.MANA, None) at abilities.py:151 and no Chronomancer ability carries a `generates` block, so there is nothing to count. Flattened to the unconditional version at roughly what CoA's typical Fragment count comes to. Same call as Venomancer Stalking's Brood Marks; the lesson both times is to check the resource before porting the talent, since Templar's Combo and Knight of Xoroth's Deathfire ARE real and did port. THE EXCLUSIVITY IS REAL THOUGH, and it was added to the ability on 6 Nov 2026: exclusive_group 'chronomancer_continuum' on both this and Flux Emitter means casting either drops the other, which is CoA's rule verbatim. The same commit fixed the ability's buff_scope from 'raid' (30 real minutes, turn duration ignored) to 'combat', and gave it a 5-turn cooldown; before that both Continuum spells were simply permanent. CoA's Pulse Driver and Conduction Burst both read 'while a Continuum spell is active', which nothing can do, so neither is built.

nodes.name: Flux Emitter
nodes.description: Teaches Flux Emitter, a Continuum device that spreads your wand attacks wide.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Empower Wand attacks to affect up to 2 additional nearby enemies for 3 sec plus 5 sec per Echo Fragment. Affected attacks deal less damage per additional enemy hit. Can only have 1 Continuum spell active at a time.' LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK. Shares exclusive_group 'chronomancer_continuum' with Singularity Core, so the two genuinely compete - the choice CoA built the spec around. The additional-targets half lives on the ability's own effects; a talent cannot add targets. Sporadic Incantations ('strikes 1 additional enemy') and Cheating Time ('extends the duration of Flux Emitter by 4 sec') are both unbuildable - the second because no payload extends a LIVE effect's duration.

nodes.name: Intuition
nodes.description: Increases your critical damage by 25% and your critical strike chance by 4%.
nodes._source: CoA level 50 passive: 'Increases your critical damage by 25%.' Ports exactly. Folded in CoA's Infinity Stone ('Increases the critical strike chance of all party and raid members by 3%. In addition, increases your critical strike chance by 3%') as the crit-chance half, keeping only the selfish clause: A TALENT EFFECT CAN NEVER REACH AN ALLY - only a party-targeted ABILITY can (abilities.py:2064) - and Chronomancer has no aura ability to convert, unlike Guardian, whose four auras were changed to target_type 'party' on 5 Nov 2026 for exactly this reason. crit_damage_pct is a FRACTION; crit_chance_physical is PERCENTAGE POINTS. Physical rather than spell because this is the wand spec and its damage comes off ranged attacks. Both were pure scalars on our side.

nodes.name: Wand Mastery
nodes.description: Your ranged attacks have a 30% chance to unleash Crystal Cannon.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Wand of Time and Shatter Echo now have a 25% chance to unleash Crystal Cannon, launching 2 quick lesser Wand auto attacks at the enemy over 1 seconds, scaling with Spirit. While Paradox Cannon is active, the chance to trigger this effect is increased by 10%.' PORTS ALMOST EXACTLY via a cast_ability proc, which takes a bare ability id. The two-ability scoping becomes on_weapon_swing (no per-ability trigger) and the 'while Paradox Cannon is active' bonus is dropped (nothing reads whether an effect is live), so 25% is set at a flat 30%. NOTE: cast_ability does NOT check that the character has learned the ability, so this would fire even without Crystal Cannon's unlock node - but that node is in this tree and at a lower tier, so a player with this talent has it.

nodes.name: Paradox Cannon
nodes.description: Teaches Paradox Cannon, a Continuum device that restores your mana.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Generate 1 Echo Fragment every 2.5 sec for 5 sec, plus an additional 5 sec per Echo Fragment consumed. Can only have 1 Continuum spell active at a time.' LOAD-BEARING UNLOCK. CoA scales this off ECHO FRAGMENTS, which are not a resource this engine has: Chronomancer is (ResourceType.MANA, None) at abilities.py:151 and no Chronomancer ability carries a `generates` block, so there is nothing to count. Flattened to the unconditional version at roughly what CoA's typical Fragment count comes to. Same call as Venomancer Stalking's Brood Marks; the lesson both times is to check the resource before porting the talent, since Templar's Combo and Knight of Xoroth's Deathfire ARE real and did port. Our version is already authored as restore_resource on mana, which is the honest translation of a resource generator when the resource it generates does not exist. It applies no status effect, so exclusive_group cannot reach it and it does not compete with the other two Continuum spells - half of CoA's rule, and the half that could not be built.

nodes.name: Resonance
nodes.description: Your ranged attacks have a 35% chance to reduce the cooldown of Hasten by 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Artificer's Wand or Crystal Cannon now has a 35% chance to reduce the cooldown of Hasten by 1 sec.' PORTS ALMOST EXACTLY - the {abilities, turns} form of reset_cooldown shaves turns rather than resetting outright, which is what CoA describes. Only the two-ability scoping goes (no per-ability proc trigger); on_weapon_swing is the wand spec's equivalent. 1 sec -> 2 turns, since a sub-turn reduction would round to nothing and Hasten's cooldown is long enough to absorb it.

nodes.name: Fate Twister
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Unstable Chronoglass by 50% and Collapse by 30%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cooldown of Unstable Chronoglass by 30 sec.' Its 1-minute cooldown halved is CoA's 30 seconds exactly, so this is a faithful port expressed as a percentage because the key is proportional. Collapse added so the node is not a one-ability pick on a 10-turn cooldown. *_cooldown_pct keys are FRACTIONS and POSITIVE MEANS A REDUCTION - the opposite sign convention from most of this file. talented_cooldown floors at 1 turn, so this cannot delete a cooldown outright.

nodes.name: Conduction Burst
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Shatter Echo by a further 25% and of Crystal Cannon by 20%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Shatter Echo now deals 20% additional damage while a Continuum spell is active.' The conditional cannot be built - nothing reads whether another effect is live, which also killed Pulse Driver and Chaos Fusion - so rather than ship a condition that silently never fires it becomes unconditional at 25%, stacking with Hyperwand's 30%. Extended to Crystal Cannon so the node pairs with Wand Mastery, and because CoA's Splitting Time ('Crystal Cannon strikes 2 additional nearby enemies') cannot be built either - nothing adds targets to an ability - so its intent lands here as damage instead. Both FRACTIONS.

nodes.name: Concentrated Fate
nodes.description: Increases your spell damage by 10% and your ranged attack power by a further 15% of your Spirit.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the effectiveness of your Echo Fragments by 20%.' CoA scales this off ECHO FRAGMENTS, which are not a resource this engine has: Chronomancer is (ResourceType.MANA, None) at abilities.py:151 and no Chronomancer ability carries a `generates` block, so there is nothing to count. Flattened to the unconditional version at roughly what CoA's typical Fragment count comes to. Same call as Venomancer Stalking's Brood Marks; the lesson both times is to check the resource before porting the talent, since Templar's Combo and Knight of Xoroth's Deathfire ARE real and did port. With nothing to be 20% more effective, the node is rebuilt along the tree's actual spine - Spirit into ranged damage - stacking with Wand Expert's 100% and the capstone's 10%. Was a pure scalar on our side. spell_damage is a FRACTION; the conversion key is a fraction too, and both read raw.

nodes.name: Timemage
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of stuns against you by 30% and increases your maximum health by 5%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the duration of harmful magic effects on you by -30%.' THE GENERAL VERSION DOES NOT EXIST: the only duration-reduction key the engine reads is stun_duration_reduction_pct, and status_effects.py:699 checks it SOLELY against effects flagged is_stun. So the description promises stuns and only stuns - the same correction Witch Doctor Brewing's Spice: Peacebloom needed after it invented `cc_duration_taken_pct`, which was caught by the audit. Roots and snares have no mechanic to shorten at all. The health is added so the node is worth a point on a class that is not stunned every fight. BOTH KEYS ARE FRACTIONS, and I authored the first as 30.0 on the assumption it was percentage points - audit_talents caught it as '1000%' and it was right. So stun_duration_reduction_pct joins crit_damage_*, all_damage and the *_cost_pct family as a fraction, against the crit_chance_*/haste/hit_rating family, which are points. There is no rule to infer it from the name; the audit is the only reliable check. max_health_pct is a fraction as a TALENT effect too, though it becomes percentage points inside a status effect.

nodes.name: Reverse Engineering
nodes.description: Increases your ranged attack power by 10% of your Spirit. Your damaging spells have a 25% chance to grant 20% haste for 3 turns and restore 60 mana.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Periodic damage and healing now has a 15% chance to increase your haste by 15% for 6 seconds and grant allies Replenishment. Replenishment replenishes 5% of maximum mana per 5 sec for 15 seconds.' CoA hangs it off PERIODIC TICKS, which are not a trigger - status_effects.py:914 ticks a dot by calling the recipient's own take_damage with no caster reference, so there is nobody to fire a proc on. Re-pointed to on_damage_cast, the eighth and last talent in this class to take that loss. The ally Replenishment becomes mana for the caster: a proc cannot grant a resource to an ally. 6 sec -> 3 turns, 15% -> 25% because a per-cast roll is far rarer than a per-tick one. The Spirit conversion is added so the capstone closes the loop the tree opened with Wand Expert and Artificer's Empowerment - Spirit into ranged damage - rather than being a proc alone. haste is PERCENTAGE POINTS; the conversion key is a FRACTION.
